mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COLLECTION_ITEM ( COLLECTION_ID, CONTENT_ID, ADDED_DT ) VALUES ( #{collectionId}, #{contentId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT COLLECTION_ID, CONTENT_ID, ADDED_DT, EXTERNAL_ID, TITLE_KO, TITLE_ORG, RELEASE_YEAR, POSTER_URL, AVERAGE_RATING FROM ( SELECT CI.COLLECTION_ID, CI.CONTENT_ID, TO_CHAR(CI.ADDED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ADDED_DT, C.EXTERNAL_ID, C.TITLE_KO, C.TITLE_ORG, TO_CHAR(C.RELEASE_YEAR, 'YYYY') AS RELEASE_YEAR, C.POSTER_URL, MR.AVERAGE_RATING, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CI.ADDED_DT DESC, CI.COLLECTION_ID DESC, CI.CONTENT_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM COLLECTION_ITEM CI INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_ID = CI.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CONTENT_ID, ROUND(AVG(RATING_SCORE), 1) AS AVERAGE_RATING FROM MEMBER_CONTENT WHERE RATING_SCORE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CONTENT_ID ) MR ON MR.CONTENT_ID = CI.CONTENT_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM
SELECT CONTENT_ID FROM COLLECTION_ITEM WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} ORDER BY ADDED_DT, CONTENT_ID
